calls.title: GrowthBook POC
calls.summary: The team discussed the implementation of a POC plan, emphasizing the establishment of a clear framework to align resources effectively. Jake Heier highlighted the importance of clarifying use cases and involving product experts for workflow reviews to mitigate blockers. Collaboration on initial experiments was proposed by Charbel El Jalkh, with the expectation of receiving quick technical support. The integration into BigQuery was a priority for Andrew Boyton, who raised concerns about the data pipeline, while Jake agreed to involve data science experts. The team also discussed optimizing costs associated with BigQuery, mentioning strategies like batching data writes. Finally, Andrew highlighted the need for a culture shift toward data-driven experimentation, with success measured by product and data science feedback.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Feature Flags, BigQuery, Experimentation, SDK, Data Pipeline
calls.action_items:
**Jake Heier**
Send information about GrowthBook’s query optimization features for BigQuery (04:03)
Consult with team and provide documentation on best practices for cost-efficient data writing to BigQuery from backend tests (09:34)
Provide documentation explaining GrowthBook’s percentage rollout and safe rollout features with automatic rollback tied to metrics (18:44)
Add support engineers, solutions engineer, and head of customer success to Slack thread and facilitate introductions (20:53)
Schedule and organize follow-up session with head of experimentation after initial POC experiment data is gathered (23:19)
Send meeting recap summarizing discussions, next steps, and resource additions in Slack channel (25:09)

**Charbel El Jalkh**
Continue working on POC by setting up experiment to push data into BigQuery and validating Gradual rollout through GrowthBook (19:21)
Coordinate with product managers to align on testing plans and involvement in review sessions (02:57)
Communicate promptly any blockers or issues encountered during POC setup (23:54)

**Andrew Boyton**
Align data science and engineering on metrics and success criteria for experiments and data pipeline optimization (03:15)
Evaluate GrowthBook in parallel with Optimizely using backend AA tests, focusing on metrics integration and analysis UX (04:54)
Discuss internal usage of feature flags and experimentation with teams to establish current adoption rates and cultural goals (12:07)
Prepare feedback and success criteria from product and data science perspectives after initial experiment runs (10:53)
